expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Version 2 is planned to expand the protocol beyond the current ping message with additional message types, more explicit encoding and decoding behavior, and stronger validation for unknown or malformed input, while keeping the existing ping round trip compatible for current users.

Shipped in v2: `Msg::Hello(String)` with the explicit `v:2|hello:<name>` envelope.
